name: gazzumatteo-claude-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins and skills by Matteo Gazzurelli — testing, automation, and productivity tools for NQL and beyond

plugins.name: e2e-testing
plugins.description: End-to-end testing workflow: create checklists from code, validate them against changes, and execute via Playwright. v0.5.2 unifies cloud (Claude) and local (LM Studio) executors behind a single `/run-checklist` dispatcher that auto-routes based on $E2E_EXECUTOR. Structured markdown + JSON reports.

plugins.name: code-optimizer
plugins.description: Scan, plan, apply, and verify code optimizations across 11 categories (dedup, type consolidation, dead code, cycles, type strengthening, error handling, AI-slop, complexity, magic constants, naming, excessive parameters). Multi-language (TS/JS, Python, generic). Regression-safe via baseline + per-batch rollback.

plugins.name: mobile-testing
plugins.description: Direct iOS Simulator and Android Emulator control without MobAI desktop app — zero rate limits. Pluggable backends: native (xcrun simctl + adb + Quartz) and Appium (XCUITest + UIAutomator2). v0.1.7 unifies cloud (Claude+MCP) and local (LM Studio) executors behind a single `/mobile-runner` dispatcher that auto-routes based on $MOBILE_EXECUTOR. Same 14 MCP tools and DSL v0.2 as MobAI MCP, plus slim DSL responses, `hide_keyboard` action, project-local screenshot dir.
